messages:
Sophie: Anyone else seeing per-model throughput graphs flatline in Console for a bunch of models? Link: https://console.redwood.internal/d/throughput

Leo: Yep, got the same. Alerts fired for multiple dashboards. Filing incident INC-2456. No API errors reported from prod though.

Sophie: Confirming — product traffic looks normal, logs show successful responses, but the per-model panels show zeros. Suspect metrics/label mismatch.

MetricsBot: Alert: Panel 'Per-model throughput' returned no series for label key `model_name`.

Tara: Quick sanity check: ran a PromQL against TSDB: `sum(rate(redwood_inference_model_requests_total[5m])) by (model_id)` and it returns values. `by (model_name)` returns empty.

Kevin: That matches a recent change — last exporter PR switched the canonical label from `model_name` to `model_id` to avoid collisions (commit: https://git.internal/r/inference/metrics/commit/abcd123). Dashboards were not updated.

Sophie: So dashboards are still selecting on `model_name` -> no matching series -> panels flatline. Do we want to patch dashboards or change exporter back?

Dave: Short-term fix: update Grafana queries to use `model_id`. Long-term: exporter should emit both `model_id` and `model_name` for compatibility, plus update runbooks. I'll prepare the dashboard hotfix.

Tara: Repro steps I used (can share in incident):
```
# check node metrics directly
curl -s http://metrics-node-01:9100/metrics | grep inference_model_requests_total | head
# output shows labels like:
inference_model_requests_total{model_id="rwd-gpt-3-small",instance="node-12"} 45234
```

Kevin: I opened a PR to exporter to add a legacy `model_name` label mapped from `model_id` for a 2-release deprecation window: https://git.internal/r/inference/metrics/pulls/789. Also added unit tests.

Sophie: Proposed plan:
- Hotfix dashboards to reference `model_id` (deploy now)
- Merge exporter PR to emit alias `model_name` (so older dashboards keep working)
- Backfill TSDB or run a metrics rewrite job to restore historical series under `model_name` if product needs historical continuity
- Add CI check that detects label key churn and blocks PRs that remove public metric labels without a migration plan

Leo: Hotfix pushed to staging and validated against staging metrics. Will promote to prod after a quick smoke.

MetricsBot: Deploy bot: dashboard hotfix deployed by Dave at 1710605267 :rocket:

Kevin: Exporter PR merged to main; will be included in next rollout. Also filed DOCS-112 to update metrics export docs and runbooks.

Sophie: Thanks — monitored dashboards for a few minutes and panels are repopulating. Leaving this thread open until we confirm no regression. :thumbsup:

Leo: Graphs back to expected numbers, historical gaps still exist for the window where labels didn't match but that's expected. Closing INC-2456 if no further alerts in 1h.

Sophie: Adding follow-ups: add label-change alerting, update runbook section 'metrics label compatibility', and schedule a short postmortem to discuss deployment gating for metrics changes.

Kevin: Noted, will add runbook entries and a checklist item for metrics label compatibility.

Dave: Thanks everyone.

Sophie: Closing loop — incident resolved, root cause: metrics exporter label rename (`model_name` -> `model_id`) without dashboard updates. Mitigations: dashboard hotfix, exporter alias, docs + CI guard.

Leo: 👍
